name_vi: Túi du lịch hình trụ ngang
description_en: A long horizontal cylindrical woven duffle with full-length textile zipper, two leather handles and reinforced round ends. Canonical front: the long curved woven body below two handle straps. Side view: a circular woven end with a leather carry grip. Rear view: the uninterrupted curved body and zipper-to-end seam. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A long horizontal cylindrical woven duffle with full-length textile zipper, two leather handles and reinforced round ends. Canonical front: the long curved woven body below two handle straps. Side view: a circular woven end with a leather carry grip. Rear view: the uninterrupted curved body and zipper-to-end seam. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: plain over-one-under-one basket weave. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
